title: Keep stage backfill's Git and library snapshot's save under the FLOW-14 stop watch (issue 75, review 5762745045 on #79)
description: Keep stage backfill's Git and library snapshot's save under the FLOW-14 stop watch (issue 75, review 5762745045 on #79)
no_spec_change_rationale: Call-site wiring for REQ-cli-011 as stated in stop-what-chough-started-when-chough-is-stopped-issue-75: stage.rs runs backfill's Git through records::run_owned, and library.rs reads the HEAD under the stop watch before staging a snapshot under a hidden name and renaming it whole. The requirement text lives in that change.
acceptance_criteria: stopping_a_backfill_stops_its_git_and_records_nothing passes: a stop while stage backfill checks its commit stops that Git and leaves .chough byte-identical,stopping_a_library_snapshot_stops_git_and_records_nothing passes: a stop while library snapshot reads the HEAD stops that Git and leaves .chough and the library byte-identical,Every other stage and library test passes
